label: GPT-6.1 Sol
output:
Dear friends, neighbors, church family, and my dear customers,

After 11 years on Bellaire Blvd, Lotus Glow Nails had a surprise we never asked for. On Sunday, November 8, around 2 in the morning, a car came through our front window.

First, please know: **I am OK, nobody was inside, and the driver is OK too.** Thank God. The police came, and her insurance will cover the damage.

Our front glass is gone, and one pedicure chair is smashed. The car stopped exactly at the pedicure chair, like she came in for a spa day. My daughter says she got the first drive-thru pedicure in Houston! The floor looks like a rainbow threw up, and my husband says finally the shop is modern art. I told him I liked the old art better.

I cried a little in the morning, but now I am OK. Glass and chairs can be replaced. People cannot. I thank God for protecting everyone.

**Lotus Glow Nails is closed for now. We hope to reopen Monday, November 16**, as our contractor expects, but the city inspector must check the wall and clear us to open first. I will let everyone know when it is confirmed.

**This week, Trang, Kim, and I are working at my cousin Hoa’s salon, Pearland Nail Bar.** To book your nails or check an appointment, please call or text my cell: **832-555-0147**.

And please don’t worry about your gift cards. They are still good. Nobody will lose their money.

Thank you for all the calls, texts, prayers, and food. Mrs. Dung brought pho this morning, so you know I am being taken care of.

Please pass this message around your group texts and emails so everybody knows where to find us. No need to worry about me. We still have our hands, our nail polish, and each other.

With love and thanks,
Your Lotus Glow Nails family
